content.text: Fixed both: undecodable lines (a session still being written) are skipped, and records with `isSidechain: true` are ignored. Subagent files themselves were never double counted — they live in `<session>/subagents/` which the `*/*.jsonl` glob doesn't reach. Two tests added; the log now reports 118 compactions in 47 sessions (99 auto, 19 manual).
